content: LLM response caching on Vercel serverless without DB: in-memory Maps are per-instance and evaporate on scale-to-zero/redeploy, so they are best-effort only; standard options are Upstash Redis free tier (HTTP-based, ~10K commands/day, works from serverless) or build-time precompute committed as static data. For a demo budget the robust pattern is committed pre-run cached responses plus best-effort in-memory runtime cache. Cross-checked Upstash + Vercel docs and dev.to guides.
